requirements.quote_summary: Persist absolute timestamps as UTC-aware instants; never use local wall-clock time as the canonical event timestamp.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All material storage/compute/ledger/event ordering uses UTC-aware instants.

requirements.quote_summary: Use IANA TZDB identifiers; fixed offsets are not canonical user time zones.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: User/profile/API timezone fields accept only IANA identifiers (UTC allowed).

requirements.quote_summary: Detect browser/device timezone via standards-based API; detection is a suggestion only.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: First eligible visit suggests browser zone without treating it as immutable identity.

requirements.quote_summary: Resolve: request override > account > session/browser > detected > UTC.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Single resolver implements documented precedence chain.

requirements.quote_summary: Authenticated users must have a persisted preferred timezone.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Account timezone column persisted and returned on profile reads.

requirements.quote_summary: Profile preferences allow manual timezone selection; explicit choice wins over detection.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Profile UI + PATCH profile API persist explicit user timezone.

requirements.quote_summary: Do not silently overwrite explicit timezone when device reports different zone.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Resolver and profile flow preserve saved account timezone over detected browser zone.

requirements.quote_summary: All conversion uses IANA rules for DST and governmental changes.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Display conversion uses ZoneInfo/TZDB; DST transitions tested.

requirements.quote_summary: Language/locale must not determine timezone.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: No code path derives timezone solely from ui_lang/locale.

requirements.quote_summary: Country/region must not be sole timezone source.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: No code path maps country alone to timezone without user preference.

requirements.quote_summary: Production hosts use synchronized clocks (NTP) and UTC server default.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Production NTP/chrony evidence required; not verifiable from repo alone.

requirements.quote_summary: Timezone-aware DB semantics (TIMESTAMPTZ equivalent); avoid naive datetime ambiguity.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: ORM models use timezone=True columns and UTC-aware defaults.

requirements.quote_summary: Expose absolute timestamps as ISO-8601/RFC3339 with Z or explicit offset.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: API/ledger timestamps use unambiguous Z/offset serialization.

requirements.quote_summary: Convert canonical instants to resolved user timezone before display.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Display paths call canonical to_display_tz or format API.

requirements.quote_summary: Date/time formatting follows locale; timezone remains independent preference.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Locale formatters do not override timezone preference.

requirements.quote_summary: Where time affects decisions, show clear timezone context/label.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Decision-critical UI shows timezone label alongside local time.

requirements.quote_summary: Chart axes/tooltips use one explicit display timezone; no silent zone mixing.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Chart components bind to resolved display timezone.

requirements.quote_summary: Preserve source provenance and canonical ordering; localization is display-only.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Market events stored UTC; ordering by canonical instant.

requirements.quote_summary: AI user-facing times use resolved user timezone unless user requests otherwise.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: AI response formatters resolve user timezone for time strings.

requirements.quote_summary: Notification scheduling/display honors user timezone; canonical events remain UTC.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Notification pipeline localizes display times from UTC canonical.

requirements.quote_summary: Transactional emails render times in user/account timezone and locale.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Email templates format times with account timezone.

requirements.quote_summary: Reports state timezone; exports preserve UTC timestamps and metadata.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Export headers include timezone metadata; body retains UTC.

requirements.quote_summary: User-visible activity renders local time; audit evidence retains UTC.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Activity UI localizes; audit rows store UTC.

requirements.quote_summary: Billing dates localize display without changing provider authority or cycle semantics.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Billing UI shows localized times; ledger/order remains UTC.

requirements.quote_summary: Recurring schedules store IANA zone + wall-clock rule, not fixed UTC offset.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Schedule model stores iana_zone + local rule fields.

requirements.quote_summary: Ambiguous/nonexistent local times have deterministic documented behavior and tests.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: resolve_local_to_utc documents fold/gap policy with failing tests.

requirements.quote_summary: Changing user timezone must never mutate historical canonical instants.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Preference change does not rewrite stored UTC instants.

requirements.quote_summary: Material timezone preference changes should be auditable.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Timezone changes append immutable audit record with UTC timestamp.

requirements.quote_summary: Reuse existing 38-locale i18n; no parallel date/time localization subsystem.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Time display reuses i18n locale formatters where applicable.

requirements.quote_summary: Audit dashboards, heroes, alerts, charts, reports, emails, notifications, billing, APIs, AI.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All listed surfaces wired to canonical time policy.

requirements.quote_summary: Reject or normalize naive datetimes at canonical boundaries; tests detect accidental usage.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: ensure_aware_utc fail-closed when enforcement ON; regression tests.

requirements.quote_summary: Use maintained IANA TZDB data; operators do not manually edit clock rules.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Runtime uses zoneinfo/IANA TZDB, not hard-coded offset tables.

requirements.quote_summary: Invalid timezone falls back to UTC for rendering with observability.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: safe_timezone returns UTC and logs warning for invalid input.

requirements.quote_summary: Timezone detection is preference signal only; not location/identity proof.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: No authorization or identity decisions based solely on detected timezone.

requirements.quote_summary: No engineering closure claim without repo-wide UTC canon, IANA handling, DST, cross-surface proof.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Truth table shows mandatory items YES or honest PARTIAL/BLOCKED with evidence.

requirements.quote_summary: Live readiness requires production evidence for clock sync, browser detection, DST notifications, cross-device.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: PASS_LIVE only with production verification; not from local tests alone.
